name: Blonde Woman
source: A senior priest of the Cleanup Department who [url=https://vndb.org/c103282]Belial[/url] meets early on alongside [url=https://vndb.org/c103285]Chairwoman[/url]. Chatty but rather lazy, she takes an interest in Belial quickly.
